items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Now just like when I was on the boat with Fate [MARABLE] ... This is Fate Marable's band, right.

ctx.x: Well you know something, you're just about in the fashion now because that's all they're doing. If you went to see Herbie Wein's Hancock's band at the George (Wingate) festival. Now these people play saxophones and flutes and everything. But half the time they are standing up just jingling bells. You know, it's really getting kind of funny. There is nothing going on except people jingling and playing percussion.
Now just like when I was on the boat with Fate [MARABLE] We had a tune we used to play 'Stop Thief' and I'd have to make shots like, you see. They
were shells you know, empty shells. But I had to hit on these things. Some kind of introduction we'd have this 'Stop Thief' you see. And I'd have to shoot these the pistols off you know.
